m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: You freed me, Wizard - getting you into that Tower is the least I can do to repay you. One wind bridge, coming up!
Aeriel told me all about the Tower layout - we'll need to make our way through two stories on our way to the top.
Here's hoping Khan doesn't have any guards!
Ohhh, I'd forgotten how much I missed frolicking in the rain! Hehehe!
NO! I am beaten. The shame!
Khan, we're not here to humiliate you. We're here to rescue you! I'm sorry I left you behind - I really did think that fall had killed you.
He was most distraught over losing you as we sailed away from Aeriel.
I can get you home! I can give you everything you want, Khan. Just let... me... help you!
So be it. Take me to Zanadu!
Sparck - be sure to get the Lux Capacitor.
Indeed, Captain. And Khan's Storm Jewel as well.
Master, are you leaving us? You must not! Who will protect us from the Beastmen?
You need not fear! Caleban no longer leads the Beastmen, I do. And I want peace. Will you share your clean water with us... please?
Of course! Will you allow us to take food from the Jungle?
Indeed. We will even help you gather it!
You see, you can move beyond the fear and hate of the past. You can build a new world, a new destiny... together!
Now, let's fix the Ark.
You're back!
You want to get into the Tower of Sycorax? Simple. It's the least I can do for the Wizard who set me free. And their dashing friend. Hehehe.
You flatter me, ma'am.
So cute! Hehehe. Head over to the Tower and I'll meet you there.
You want to get into the Tower of Sycorax? Head over to it and I'll help you.
